parameters.content:
## CARD 1: 🧠 TENDER INTELLIGENCE AGENT
Deterministic tender specification analysis.
Extracts and normalizes financial thresholds, experience clauses, statutory requirements, and benchmarks bidder evidence.

## CARD 2: ⚙️ DETERMINISTIC EXTRACTION RULES
Normalizes Indian currency notations (Crores, Lakhs) and dates.
Evaluates requirement coverage without inventing false passes when evidence is missing.
